title: A Reaction-Diffusion Theory of Microvascular Pharmacological Sanctuaries and Inflammatory Pre-conditioning Explains Post-Adjuvant Relapse Dynamics Across 3,461 Patients
description: Comprehensive open-access code, biophysical continuum reaction-diffusion models, survival analysis pipelines, and supplementary materials for the study: 'A Reaction-Diffusion Theory of Microvascular Pharmacological Sanctuaries and Inflammatory Pre-conditioning Explains Post-Adjuvant Relapse Dynamics Across 3,461 Patients'. Evaluated across 11 clinical cohorts (N = 3,461) including MSKCC targeted TKI, real-world surgical cohorts with raw CBC and inflammatory biomarkers, TCGA pan-cancer, and blinded negative controls.
